apply.title: Lehigh Admissions — Applying to Lehigh (application deadlines)

test_policy.notes: Lehigh "has adopted a test-optional policy regarding submission of SAT or ACT scores indefinitely." Scores are considered only if the applicant chooses to report them; official scores must reach Lehigh before the first day of classes. SAT/ACT are superscored.

requirements.notes: Common App or Coalition (Scoir) application with the Lehigh Questions and Writing Supplement; School Report with counselor recommendation and official transcript; one teacher recommendation; mid-year school report. Interviews are not required, but "all interviews are evaluative and become part of your application." Non-U.S. citizens who will need aid must submit the CSS Profile (or ISAFA if the $25 fee is a hardship) by the application deadline; other non-citizens need no Certificate of Finances at application. Fee waiver for hardship available to non-citizens by request.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Binding. Decision date "Mid December" (no fixed date published). Aid applicants send CSS Profile and tax forms by Nov 1.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II
deadlines.notes: Binding. Decision date "Mid February" (no fixed date published). Aid applicants send CSS Profile and tax forms by Jan 15.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision date "Late March" (no fixed date published). The page states no entry year; treated as the 2026-27 cycle (Fall 2027 entry). Lehigh has no Early Action.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required unless the applicant's first language is English or the last two full years of formal instruction (not counting the current year) were in English. TOEFL and IELTS are preferred; TOEFL iBT Home Edition and Duolingo are considered if those exams are unavailable. SAT/ACT cannot be used to meet the requirement. Scores must come directly from the testing agency.

english.notes: No hard minimum: "the most competitive candidates score above a 90". Page's readiness bands: 95+ strong, 86-94 may need extra language support, 85 or below raises concern (tests before Jan 21, 2026).
Page's band for tests from Jan 21, 2026: 5.5+ strong readiness, 4.0-5.0 may need extra language support, 4.0 or below raises concern.
No hard minimum: "the most competitive candidates score above" 7.0. Readiness bands: 7.5+ strong, 6.5-7.0 may need extra support, 6.0 or below raises concern.
Considered if TOEFL/IELTS are not available to the student. "Most competitive" at 120; readiness bands: 120+ strong, 110-119 may need extra support, 109 or below raises concern.

aid.notes: Lehigh has limited international financial aid and "is need-aware in the admissions process" for non-U.S. citizens; some applicants who apply for aid but show no need may be admitted without an aid offer. Aid packages range from a few thousand dollars to full tuition, room and board, with no additional aid after the initial offer. Merit scholarships range from $5,000 to full tuition with no separate application. CSS Profile required by the application deadline for any applicant who will need aid in any year.
